## Teaching points

1. Cluster attacks combine severe unilateral orbital pain, agitation and ipsilateral autonomic symptoms. High-concentration oxygen can abort an attack.
2. High-concentration oxygen via reservoir mask is an available acute treatment. Subcutaneous or nasal triptan is another guideline-supported option, but absent from the game catalog.
3. Arrange access to rescue treatment and specialist prevention; a remote normal scan does not excuse ignoring a changed headache pattern.
